title: EzItemBlock
description: The only item blocker you'll ever need! Block any item with ease.
body:
**DM ME ON DC [USER-WolfJTA] IF YOU WANT ME TO UPDATE THIS PLUGIN WITH A FEATURE YOU WANT OR TO HAVE ME MAKE A PLUGIN FOR YOU (FREEE)**

This Purpur/Paper Plugin is very, very straightforward. It allows you to block items on your server, completely Disabling players ability to have said items. /disable <item> is the command for this. Have Fun!
